cross_item_pattern.rule: In a CV item that asks which viewpoint a stated hypothetical finding strengthens or is consistent with, and whose options read 'Scientist/Hypothesis X, because ...', choose the option whose because-clause restates the finding's own feature in the same direction (same-year death -> 'died within a year or two'; gradual transition -> 'predicts a gradual transition'; shorter first-year stopovers -> 'stopovers have shortened for all birds'; molten zone at 6 km -> 'unsolidified magma about 6 km down'; aphids land on yellow -> 'aphids that avoid red would land on yellow'). Applied without the passage it picks the key on 5 of 5 (chance 1 in 4), across 4 passages in both forms.
